messages:
Ashley: quick heads-up — noticed a p95/p99 spike for paged-attn on the long-seq path after yesterday's runtime tweak. Dashboard: https://dash/redwood/attn#paged-attn :alarm_clock:
Miguel: saw that too. p99 jumped from ~110ms -> ~250ms for seq>2048 on the flash-paged route. Repro locally in canary cluster.
Kai: my hunch is kernel selector fallback ordering changed; default pref might be preferring flash-paged-variant-B over fused-flash for certain seq shapes. Did we touch selection heuristics? :thinking:
Sam: I ran a quick trace, KV-cache hit-rate dropped ~30% on those requests (cold prefix behavior). That could amplify tail latency.
perf-bot: smoke-run summary for canary-2026-03-16:
```
model: rwd-7b-fused
route: /generate
seq: 3072
before (master@a1b2c3): p50 42ms p95 112ms p99 118ms
after (runtime@d4e5f6): p50 48ms p95 238ms p99 265ms
kv-hits: 0.73 -> 0.51
```
Miguel: putting git bisect on the runtime image now to find the change that nudged kernel ordering.
Ashley: hold any rollout that forces flash-paged-variant-B to be preferred. Can we pin fused-flash as fallback for seq>1024 until we understand?
Kai: snapshot of selector config at deploy time: `selector_weights: { fused:0.6, flash_paged:0.4 }` — but recent change bumped flash_paged to 0.65 in release 2026-03-15 (PR #892).
Sam: quick micro-bench: fused-flash has slightly worse throughput for batch=64 but much better single-request latency for long seqs (KV locality matters). That matches perf delta.
Miguel: git-bisect found suspect commit runtime@f7e9a1 — alters `kernel_score` calc to favor kernel latency_est for median batch sizes, deprioritizing KV-locality score. Repro steps I used:
```
# reproduce locally
./tools/run-smoke --model rwd-7b-fused --seq 3072 --batch 8 --profile
# profile output (truncated)
attn.select: chosen=flash_paged-variant-B score=0.87 kv_factor=0.51 latency_est=0.72
attn.exec: p99 248ms
```
Ashley: thanks. Can we revert the scoring tweak or tune weights? If fix is simple, hotfix to restore previous kernel scoring heuristics. Otherwise pin fused as Kai suggested.
Kai: I opened a quick PR to revert the scoring change (https://git.redwood/pr/938) and added a feature-flag for the new heuristic. Also added an integration test to catch KV-hit regressions.
perf-bot: perf regression alert cleared in canary after PR-938 deploy (manual):
```
after-hotfix: p95 118ms p99 126ms kv-hits 0.71
```
Miguel: will run broader load tests (multi-tenant) overnight and post results.
Sam: added a short note in runbook to watch kv-hit rolling 5m and selector churn for next 48h.
Ashley: great work — hold on full rollout until Miguel's tests green. Thanks all :thumbsup:
